meta.title: 美妆口播怎么剪？把握本质才好出效果
meta.title_en: How to Edit Beauty Voiceovers: Master the Essence

scenes.title_en: Opening: Learn Editing by Breaking Down
scenes.context: 拉片是提升剪辑水平最快的方式之一，今天带大家拆解一个美妆口播博主的前30秒钩子设计。
sentences: 拉片是提升剪辑最快的方式。
Breaking down edits is the fastest way to improve.
今天拆解美妆口播的前30秒。
Today we break down the first 30 seconds.
paraphrase: Breaking down edits is the fastest way to improve.
Today we break down the first 30 seconds.
scenes.speak: Breaking down edits is the fastest way to improve. Today we break down the first 30 seconds.

scenes.context: 开篇是一句简单明了的钩子，直接把对话题感兴趣的粉丝留住，这是口播的第一道关卡。
sentences: Hold the viewers who care about the topic.
paraphrase: Hold the viewers who care about the topic.
scenes.speak: Open with a clear hook. Hold the viewers who care about the topic.

scenes.title_en: The Script Is the Edit Blueprint
scenes.context: 博主写文案时就已构思好剪辑内容，想好字幕入场动画，花字从左右滑进搭配叮的音效。
sentences: 花字配入场动画和音效。
Animated captions come with a ding.
paraphrase: Animated captions come with a ding.
scenes.speak: The script pre-plans the edit. Animated captions come with a ding.

scenes.title_en: The Two Roles of an Account Endorsement
scenes.context: 账号背书有两个作用：一是给新观众做自我介绍让人知道你是干嘛的，二是帮老粉丝快速找到往期视频。
sentences: Endorsement two: call back old fans.
paraphrase: Endorsement two: call back old fans.
scenes.speak: Endorsement one: introduce yourself. Endorsement two: call back old fans.

scenes.context: 旧视频封面用关键帧动画从右往左，把人像抠出来放在前面，配合弹幕评论增加互动感。
sentences: 把弹幕直接放在画面上。
Layer the danmaku right on the frame.
paraphrase: Layer the danmaku right on the frame.
scenes.speak: Animate the cover with keyframes. Layer the danmaku right on the frame.

scenes.context: 把视频分两层：上层抠出人像加口型描边，下层关键帧动画缩小，做出有网感的效果。
sentences: Cut out the top layer and outline it.
Shrink the bottom layer with keyframes.
paraphrase: Cut out the top layer and outline it.
Shrink the bottom layer with keyframes.
scenes.speak: Cut out the top layer and outline it. Shrink the bottom layer with keyframes.

scenes.context: 博主本人背书要告诉观众我为什么能站在这里讲，因为我去过90%以上的热门店亲身测过。
sentences: 我亲身测过才有资格讲。
I tested it myself, so I can speak.
paraphrase: I tested it myself, so I can speak.
scenes.speak: Use experience to build trust. I tested it myself, so I can speak.

scenes.context: 花字、效果、音效都可以换，只要把握住本质，意思到了，效果自然就出来了。
sentences: Hold the essence and effects follow.
paraphrase: Hold the essence and effects follow.
scenes.speak: Captions and sounds are replaceable. Hold the essence and effects follow.

practice: 拉片是提升剪辑水平最快的方式。
Breaking down edits is the fastest way to improve.
写文案时就要构思剪辑。
Hold the essence and effects follow.
pitfalls: 口播开头直接自我介绍
钩子决定前几秒的留存率
自我介绍+召唤老粉即可
花字音效可换本质不变
